content:
alex.w: Heads-up: starting a pass this afternoon to vet high-priv service accounts and cross-acct KMS admins. Goal: remove any entitlements unused >90d. Will coordinate canary revocations. :eyes:
maria.k: sgtm — can you share scope? are we hitting Dedicated's svcacct pool or cross-account roles?
alex.w: Primarily cross-acct KMS admins + IAM roles with 'Admin' tag. Not touching SRE-managed infra svcaccts unless they appear ownerless. I'll post query + runbook.
security-bot: Automated scan result: 42 accounts with last-key-usage > 120d; 7 admin role bindings without owner label. https://internal/redwood/sec/reports/1758624321
jordan_r: Can we do a canary: drop one admin binding in staging-like project and monitor alerts for 48h? Prefer to avoid mass removals.
alex.w: Yes — plan: 1) create 'canary-removal' PR for svcacct:infra-ops in project-beta; 2) hold 48h; 3) if no alerts, proceed 10% per day. PR template: ```gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding project-beta --member='serviceAccount:svcacct-infra-ops@project-beta.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.admin'```
sre-liz: I'll own the canary and watch pager during business hrs. ping me when PR is up.
maria.k: We should export current ACLs and attach to ticket for quick rollback. Also tag any service with 'priv-check:manual-required' if automation can't prove owner.
alex.w: Good call. I'll attach CSV and a heatmap (token usage vs last auth). Also proposing a temporary 'entitlement-freeze' policy for affected projects during rollout.
jordan_r: One risk: KMS key policy delegations to cross-account roles used by partner ingestion pipeline. We need smoke test steps. @maria.k can you add test commands?
maria.k: Added smoke tests to PR: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' https://ingest.partner.example/decrypt-ping``` plus decrypt test `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext <FILE> --location global --keyring kr-ingest --key key-01`. Details in PR.
alex.w: Reminder: least-priv checklist: owner, last-auth, key-usage, recent deploys, associated runbook link. Anyone object to proceeding noon PT?
sre-liz: :thumbsup: no objections. Will watch canary from 12:30–16:30 PT.
security-bot: Scheduled job created: entitlement-sweep-1758624321 at 2025-02-14T19:00:00Z. Alerts will route to #eng-oncall.
jordan_r: One ask: make sure KMS audit logs retained for 90d in central project prior to rollout. Logs show decrypt events for a few keys last week.
alex.w: Agree — ops to confirm retention. @sre-liz can you confirm? Also tagging legal/compliance in ticket for evidence retention.
sre-liz: Confirmed 90d in central logs. I'll add evidence to ticket.
maria.k: If anyone wants to mitigate risk: can we enable temp scoped roles instead of removal, like reduce from 'KMS Admin' to 'KMS CryptoOperator' for 7 days? Might help fragile integrations.
alex.w: We can do staged downgrades for sensitive bindings. Adding that to runbook.
jordan_r: :fire: nice. Let's keep PR small. Alex, drop link and I'll review.
alex.w: PR: https://internal/pulls/5238 — includes CSV, heatmap, canary steps, rollback commands. Starting now.
